mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the pulling threads was most worthwhile because the resulting picture connected the cell's components to muscle shortening.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the nuclei, ribosomes and mitochondria became somewhat repetitive because the named slots made each choice predictable, though the explanations helped connect their roles.

surprise.text: The final picture clarified that the filaments slide past one another and remain the same length as the repeating unit shortens.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and named slots generally suggested their purposes.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see how these muscle fibers become tissues and connect to other body systems. I would hope for more decisions that require thinking beyond matching an item to a named slot.
